Useful output over time

Challenge the assumptions What can each action learn?

Changes apply from week 1 to both plans, using the same seeded world and observations.

Research observes what users need, with noise and diminishing returns. It does not resolve technical uncertainty. Shipping exposes technical mistakes and gives a weaker signal about needs; those observations arrive after the selected delay.

Useful output = build effort × exp(−2.8 × need error − 2.4 × technical error). This is an illustrative fit score, not a forecast or financial value. No staffing, rework, task sizes or learning between team members.
